 CIO Greatest Hits: Public Pensions – Ash Williams (Florida SBA) Aug 11, 2025

 This week’s Summer Series is with Ash
Williams, the former CIO of the Florida State Board of
Administration, where he oversaw one of the largest state pension
funds in the US. Ash was an innovator in the space, modernizing the
compensation scheme, asset allocation, and governance in a public
pension fund – a notoriously tricky political seat.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
